huang.preparation: Female3–8days at surgery, awake/head-fixed, rightbrain laser-window voltage imaging1000Hz; behavior tested in separate flies.
huang.stimulus: 1%EtA is v/v dilution in mineral oil,200ml/min total airflow;15s trial with odor5–10s, >=2min between odors. Response is5s odor mean minus preceding5s baseline.
huang.normalization: Optical signals are denoised/photobleach-corrected; spikes detected above cell-specific thresholds after40ms median subtraction, rates use100ms sliding window. These are inferred spikes from voltage imaging, not unitary synaptic currents.
huang.uncertainty: SEM across20spontaneous or12odor flies, not a confidence interval or within-cell tolerance. Cohorts differ. Friedman five-odor p values MBON12=.070,MBON13=.540,MBON14=.820 do not prove equivalence. Positive population EAmeans include negativeindividualresponses (1,3,0 respectively).
